# Release 2.1

This release adds **pool stats**, _faster_ retries and removes ~legacy~ options.

## Highlights

*   New `Pool.Stats` method
    *   idle counter
    *   busy counter
*   Rate limiter sets `Retry-After`

## Example

```go
stats := pool.Stats()
fmt.Println(stats.Idle, stats.Busy)
```
